visual_sample_review.result: sampled images showed potted plants consistent with folder labels; not an exhaustive visual review

prepared_dataset.transform: Long side <=512 px; JPEG quality 86; Pillow LANCZOS; remove EXIF/GPS; seed 42 class-stratified 70/15/15 split

rights_review.basis: Mendeley Data v1 displays CC BY 4.0. The dataset page describes images collected from BADC and nearby nurseries; the associated article credits the authors with data collection.
rights_review.privacy_action: EXIF/GPS removed from all prepared images

limitations: 56 images were reviewed visually; every image was decoded but not individually reviewed by a person.
Plant names are the dataset labels and were not independently taxonomically verified.
The data represent plants collected in Bangladesh and do not represent all household plants in Japan.
Predictions must not be used for toxicity, edibility, disease, care, or human/pet safety decisions.
